### Observed differences

- Two activities disappeared from the observed behaviour: A01 ran in about 64 in 100 earlier traces (about 0.9 times per trace, mid-trace) but in none of the 200 later traces, where A12 instead leads to A09 (about 49 in 100) or A08 (about 51 in 100) after previously routing to A01 in about 54 in 100 of its outgoing transitions; A17 ran exactly once in every earlier trace at the very end (median relative position 1.0) and in none later [OCC001, OCC008, POS001, POS012, DIR001, DIR008].
- One activity appeared: A07 was not observed earlier but runs in about 68 in 100 later traces (about 1.05 times per trace), early in the trace (mean relative position 0.32), leading to A03 or A04 in roughly equal shares, while A03 now leads to A07 in about half of its outgoing transitions where earlier it led to A02 [OCC004, POS005, DIR003, DIR006].
- A06 and A16 became mandatory, single, closing steps: earlier each appeared in about 40 in 100 traces with about 2 occurrences each at mid-trace positions (mean about 0.44); in the later window each appears exactly once in every trace at the end (mean positions 0.96 and 0.94), A06's only observed successor is A16 and A16's only observed successor is A06, in both orders in similar shares (about 48 vs 52 in 100) at a one-event gap [OCC003, OCC007, POS004, POS011, DIR005, DIR011, REL045, LAG022, LAG058].
- The route into the closing pair changed: earlier A04 split its outgoing flow between A17 (about 49 in 100) and A10 (about 52 in 100) and A10 always led to A17; in the later window A04 always leads to A10, A10 leads to A16 (about 53 in 100) or A06 (about 47 in 100), and A10 sits earlier in the trace (mean relative position 0.95 to 0.81) [DIR004, DIR007, DIR012, POS007, LAG021].
- Several activities repeat much more often in the later window: A02 about 9 occurrences per trace versus about 2 earlier (participation roughly unchanged at about 69–71 in 100), A14 about 4.5 versus 1.0 (participation about 28 to 55 in 100), A15 about 4.6 versus 1.1 (about 40 to 63 in 100), and A13 now always leads to A02 where earlier it split between A11 and A12 [OCC002, OCC005, OCC006, DIR002, DIR009].

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

Screening tested 188 control-flow units and flagged 171 items, where an unchanged process would typically produce fewer than one, and each flagged difference is larger than about 995 in 1000 random re-splits of the two windows, so the volume of flagged behaviour cannot be explained by random variation [OCC001, OCC004, OCC008, DIR005, REL031].

The evidence supports the possibility of a structural change in the later window rather than a shift in how often existing paths are taken: A01 and A17 are no longer observed (earlier in about 64 in 100 and in all 200 traces respectively), A07 is newly observed (absent earlier, in about 68 in 100 later traces, connected to A03 and A04), and A06 and A16 — earlier optional and repeating at mid-trace — now run exactly once in every later trace as the closing pair in either order, reached through A04 and A10 in place of the earlier closing pair A10 and A17 [OCC001, OCC003, OCC004, OCC007, OCC008, DIR004, DIR005, DIR007, DIR011, POS004, POS011, REL045].

The supporting signs are direct and consistent: the participation flips are complete rather than partial (128 to 0, 200 to 0, 0 to 136, and 79 to 200 out of 200 traces), the successor changes are observed at A04, A10, A06 and A16 themselves, and the relational and positional items agree — A04–A06, A04–A16, A06–A10 and A10–A16 co-occur in all later traces in a fixed order, A06–A16 co-occur in both orders, and A06 and A16 sit at the trace end while A10 moved earlier [OCC001, OCC003, OCC004, OCC007, OCC008, DIR004, DIR005, DIR007, DIR011, POS004, POS007, POS011, REL031, REL035, REL039, REL045, REL062]. The evidence cannot show whether these differences stem from one coordinated modification or from several independent ones, and zero participation only means an activity was not observed, so very rare occurrences of A01 or A17 in the later window cannot be excluded [OCC001, OCC008].

Other differences: A02, A14 and A15 repeat far more often in the later window (A02 about 9 versus about 2 occurrences per trace; A14 about 4.5 versus 1.0; A15 about 4.6 versus 1.1), A02's outgoing transitions moved from A16, A06, A03 and A04 to A15, A11, A14 and A12, and A13 now always leads to A02 where earlier it split between A11 and A12 [OCC002, OCC005, OCC006, DIR002, DIR009].
